# nixarchy.plugin-browser

> Browse the Omarchy plugin marketplace from the keyboard, and audit any
> plugin in a bubblewrap sandbox before it is installed: a security verdict
> and a NixOS-compatibility verdict. It installs plugins disabled, pinned to
> the audited commit, and can hand NixOS findings to the default agent to
> explain or fix a copy. On nixarchy it is the panel behind
> Setup ▸ Plugins ▸ Add Plugin.

## Manual

- [What this is](https://olafkfreund.github.io/nixarchy-plugin-browser/manual/): the problem, and every page
- [Getting started](https://olafkfreund.github.io/nixarchy-plugin-browser/manual/getting-started): on nixarchy, with the flake, or by hand
- [The panel](https://olafkfreund.github.io/nixarchy-plugin-browser/manual/the-panel): searching, the details, every key, script payloads
- [The audit](https://olafkfreund.github.io/nixarchy-plugin-browser/manual/the-audit): the sandbox, the security verdict, the NixOS verdict
- [Asking your agent](https://olafkfreund.github.io/nixarchy-plugin-browser/manual/the-agent): e and f, what the agent gets, the remaining risk
- [Installing a plugin](https://olafkfreund.github.io/nixarchy-plugin-browser/manual/installing): disabled, pinned installs, and adding by URL
- [Previews and privacy](https://olafkfreund.github.io/nixarchy-plugin-browser/manual/previews-and-privacy): what is fetched, preview checks, the off switches
- [From a terminal](https://olafkfreund.github.io/nixarchy-plugin-browser/manual/from-a-terminal): omarchy-plugin-browser, omarchy-plugin-audit, nixarchy-plugin-fix
- [Troubleshooting](https://olafkfreund.github.io/nixarchy-plugin-browser/manual/troubleshooting): re-login, bwrap, keys, restarts
